notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.content: We have just released a patch that includes some performance improvements. Should enable some of you to have a smoother experience. Thanks for playing! - Talha

notes.title: v1.007
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improvements to conveyor belt "connect bases" objective logic, with various bug fixes.
[*] 3D camera invert setting in settings
[*] Now if you put an item on top of another item in the inventory, you can swap it automatically (if there is only one item colliding with the currently held item)
[/list]

notes.title: Handmade stop-motion digging adventure Mashina arrives July 31
notes.content:
From the team that made Judero, the handmade stop-motion digging adventure Mashina is set to arrive on July 31st.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/handmade-stop-motion-digging-adventure-mashina-arrives-july-31/
